mentions.h: WELCOME TO OUR IRISH GUARDS MEMBERS
mentions.note: new member from the Irish Guards
Irish Guards, stationed in Germany; won Club Championships shot; headed club hammer rankings 1983

photos.c: Left; Phil Mackay who is currently stationed with the other of our Irish Guards members in Germany returned this summer to compete for us in the Southern League and competed at the Club Championships. He won the Shot Competition and also headed the Club hammer rankings for the year.

photo.caption: Left; Phil Mackay who is currently stationed with the other of our Irish Guards members in Germany returned this summer to compete for us in the Southern League and competed at the Club Championships. He won the Shot Competition and also headed the Club hammer rankings for the year.
